violations.text: At the time of inspection, the food items in the front sandwich prep units were observed at 47-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Per the PIC, foods were stocked from colder refrigeration 2 hours prior to inspection. Food items were moved to the colder refrigeration for cooling and proper cold storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The following equipment was observed in need of adjustment/repair: - The front sandwich prep units were observed not maintaining proper temperature of Time/Temperature Control for Safety Foods (foods items observed at 47-50 degrees Fahrenheit). Per the PIC, new refrigeration units are due for arrival and replacement within 24 hrs. of this inspection.). PIC is to work from smaller portions of foods stored in colder refrigeration. PIC is to notify inspector of confirmation of refrigeration replacement. (Ice was added to cold wells at time of inspection.) - The walk-in cooler door gasket was observed to be torn. Owner stated proper gasket is on order for replacement. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
